description: List the Alfa Laval documents whose printed figures Dolphin Centrifuge offers, with document number, date and the machines each covers: the five MAB "S" technical data sheets (TD S93303E to S93307E, dated 1/73) and the MAPX / MOPX throughput table (MPCO 20-00-02). These are figures as printed by Alfa Laval in the named document, units as printed, not Dolphin measurements, guarantees or ratings; nothing is converted or calculated.
name: list_alfa_laval_published_documents
title: List Alfa Laval published documents
